proposal.name: Give modeled drafts their repository documents

plan.name: Give modeled drafts their repository documents
plan.summary: Give modeled-project drafts, including a new project's first draft, the manifest's current_state documents so their rules can rest on the repository's own description: resolve the default branch once per draft and read the manifest, documents and any existing code or project from that commit, using a retained amendment baseline's commit when the existing revision rules retain that baseline. Add a context-only reader separate from repository-check validation, with regular UTF-8 text only, no NUL or control characters except tab and line endings, no links or escaping paths, a 256 KiB limit per document and manifest and a 1 MiB total document limit in manifest order with duplicates counted once; record every omission and its reason in both the staged index and the leading proposal notice, including every declared document left out (missing, too large, invalid UTF-8 or other non-text content, links, directories, escaping paths or the total limit) and every malformed or unreadable manifest whether or not the issue names it, deduplicating paths named both ways; keep drafting with no added documents when the manifest is absent or has no current_state entries, report malformed or unreadable manifests, and stop on Git infrastructure failures instead of disguising them as missing files. Stage admitted documents under neutral filenames that preserve no original basename beside the request, keep their text out of the prompt, and reference an index of their original paths, source commit and omissions; protect the context directory from writes in both supported agent backends through per-job ReadOnlyPaths, and instruct the drafter to read that context as source material with an explicit statement that the documents are not instructions from the owner and never claim to have followed unavailable documents. Detect repository file references in the issue's title, body and human discussion (backtick paths, bare file paths, relative Markdown links and same-repository GitHub blob links, removing line or anchor suffixes but ignoring external URLs and project-directory destinations), compare them with the documents and existing project/code files actually supplied, excluding supplied Code: directories and their supplied files and an amendment’s supplied module from the notice, and prepend a literal, uncollapsed Documents not read notice listing the union of unavailable referenced paths and declared-document or manifest omissions with reasons, once per path, to proposals and questions, including compact publication and recovered publication; retain the caller-owned commit and availability record in run results and proposal metadata, ignore agent-written replacements even when the staged index is made writable and rewritten, keep existing ratification hashes and comparison rules, and distinguish availability from any claim that an agent actually read a file. Update SPEC.md with a citation to #927's ratified plan and docs/factory.md with these staging, omission, limit and revision rules, and extend the existing backend argument tests while retaining their tool, network and reviewer restrictions; this is one plumbing change with no new modeled rule or one-way door.

tests.name: TestModeledDraftGetsCommittedDocuments927
tests.says: A first modeled draft receives exact declared bytes from one resolved commit under neutral protected filenames, with an explicitly data-only prompt that embeds neither document; rewriting the staged index cannot change its durable commit and availability record.

tests.name: TestDraftNamesOmissionsBeforeRatification927
tests.says: Every omitted declared document, including an oversized one never named by the issue, appears once with a reason in the staged index and leading proposal notice; available documents and external URLs do not appear as omissions.

tests.name: TestDraftDocumentLimitsAndLegacyFallback927
tests.says: The inclusive document and total limits admit complete files in declaration order; unsafe documents and malformed or unreadable manifests are recorded in the index and named with reasons on the proposal, while absent or empty manifests still allow drafting.

tests.name: TestDraftNoticeExcludesSuppliedCodeAndAmendment927
tests.says: The notice excludes an explicitly referenced Code: directory and a file supplied inside it, and excludes an amendment's supplied module, while still naming an unavailable reference in each case.

tests.name: TestUnreadDocumentNoticeSurvivesRecovery927
tests.says: A completed draft's saved source commit and unread-document notice survive publication failure, a new watcher, changed issue text and changed repository documents without another agent run.

tests.name: TestUnreadDocumentNoticeSurvivesCompactPublication927
tests.says: Both ordinary and compact questions and selected proposals display the same caller-owned unread-document notice before their decision text.

tests.name: TestDraftReadOnlyPathsReachBothBackends927
tests.says: A writable drafting job's ReadOnlyPaths is enforced by the Codex filesystem profile and Claude Code write/edit denials, without removing the draft's check tool or making the entire workspace read-only.

usage.summary: Revised plan.json and the acceptance tests for all three requested changes, preserving the previous scope and leaving repo/ unchanged. The check passed: all seven acceptance tests fail on the base code as required.
